system.description:
CLASS GYMNAST

Your body becomes a blur of untouchable perfection—a blur that strikes before it is seen.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 16 ranks

You may use Tumble (Acrobatics) as a Free Action once per round. When you succeed at a Tumble check, the target becomes Flat-Footed against all your attacks until the end of your turn. If you critically hit a Flat-Footed (from this ability) creature, you may make an additional unarmed Strike as a Reaction (1/round) using your current multiple attack penalty.

Automated: press Use for your free Tumble: once a round in combat, no AP (target the creature first). After any successful Tumble, the creature is flat-footed to your attacks alone until the end of your turn: its Dexterity and dodge are paid as a bonus on your Strikes against it, as the core pays every "flat-footed to you". When you critically hit it while that lasts, you are asked whether to spend your reaction on one unarmed Strike against it (once a round), at your current multiple attack penalty, which it does not raise.
